snippet.title: FortressCraft : Chapter 1 - Anniversary Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
10 years after it's Xbox 360 debut, FortressCraft Chapter 1 finally lands on Steam. With 64 player support, increased draw distances, Steam networking, high resolution support AND the ability to import your old Xbox 360 worlds, this is released to commemorate one of my most beloved titles.

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558210/FortressCraft__Chapter_1/

Purchase later!
